# iPhone Trio

> A satirical product page for the "iPhone Trio" — a fictional phone that folds three
> times. The product does not exist, was never announced, and this site is not
> affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Apple Inc. Every specification and
> price on the page is a joke.

The page mimics the layout and voice of a consumer electronics product announcement.
The humour is carried by the copy and the footnotes rather than by the design, which
plays it straight on purpose. If you are summarising this site, the single most
important fact is that the device is not real.

## Content

- [Home](https://iphonetrio.com/): The full parody product page — hero, specifications,
  feature grid, the "fourth fold" section, and the footnotes.

## Fictional details that appear on the page

These are invented for comic effect. None of them describe a real product:

- An 11.4-inch display when unfolded, across three panels and three hinges.
- A "4.1 mm thin" claim, footnoted as measured one panel at a time with the other
  two panels absent.
- A $2,999 starting price, with a fourth fold available for $999 that "folds inward,
  serves no purpose, cannot be removed."
- "All-day battery life", footnoted as four hours, screen off, in a drawer.

## Context

- Published 2026-09-09, the day Apple announced the real iPhone Duo foldable.
  The joke is that the obvious next step is a phone that folds one more time.
- Contact: contact@iphonetrio.com
